name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_description: Central sector scheme providing supplementary financial income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to eligible landholding farmer families across India.
intended_audience: Small, marginal, and all cultivable landholding farmer families subject to statutory exclusion criteria.
key_benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
short_description: Comprehensive risk coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising from unforeseen natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
intended_audience: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
key_benefits: Capped farmer premium (1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for commercial/horticulture crops) with remaining premium shared by government.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
short_description: Adequate and timely institutional credit to farmers under a single window for comprehensive cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied farm activities.
intended_audience: Individual farmers, joint borrowers, tenant farmers, self-help groups (SHGs), and joint liability groups (JLGs).
key_benefits: Short-term credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at an effective 4% interest rate upon prompt repayment (with 3% interest subvention).

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
short_description: Promotes efficient water management on farms through Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler systems).
intended_audience: Farmers cultivating land with access to confirmed water source desiring micro-irrigation installations.
key_benefits: Up to 55% financial subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation equipment.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
short_description: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
intended_audience: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperative Societies, FPOs, SHGs, and Agri-entrepreneurs.
key_benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum up to a limit of ₹2 crore for a maximum tenure of 7 years.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
short_description: Sub-component of Soil Health Management that encourages organic farming practices through cluster formation and PGS-India certification.
intended_audience: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 or more hectares for continuous organic adoption.
key_benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is given directly to farmers for organic inputs.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
short_description: Increases farm power availability for small and marginal farmers by promoting custom hiring centres and subsidizing modern machinery purchase.
intended_audience: Individual farmers, cooperative societies, farmer groups, and private entrepreneurs setting up farm machinery hubs.
key_benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, reapers, seed drills, and specialized farm implements.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
short_description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
intended_audience: Farmers, FPOs, traders, commission agents, and institutional buyers seeking transparent price discovery.
key_benefits: Online transparent bidding, warehouse-based trading, real-time online payment settlement, and inter-mandi trade access.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
short_description: Comprehensive scheme aimed at strengthening farmers' infrastructure, agribusiness entrepreneurship, and risk mitigation.
intended_audience: Farmer producer organizations (FPOs), agripreneurs, rural youth, and agricultural startups.
key_benefits: Grant-in-aid financial support up to ₹25 lakh for agribusiness incubatees and innovative farming solutions.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
short_description: Assists state governments to issue soil health cards to all farmers containing status of 12 nutrient parameters and customized fertilizer recommendations.
intended_audience: All farmers seeking scientific recommendations for optimal crop input cost reduction.
key_benefits: Customized soil test report issued every 3 years with dosage recommendations for chemical fertilizers and bio-fertilizers.
